Finding: Long-run execution retains large numbers of SQLite/WAL file descriptors until the process exhausts its open-file limit.
Reproduction: Run the complete 266-test suite in one process. The completed run ends with Errno 24 and sqlite3 unable-to-open errors. A monitored rerun reached 331 FDs by 54%; most were inventory.sqlite3/WAL handles from prior tests.
Impact: A long-running operator session or repeated imports/reviews can eventually fail database operations and unrelated file access.
Required Fix: Audit every connection owner; explicitly close SQLite connections in finally/context-managed helpers; stop retaining completed-job resources; add an FD-growth regression test across repeated workflows.

Finding: The same source folder can start two independent preview jobs and both can reach READY; concurrent commits collide on the same staging directory.
Reproduction: Open Import in two tabs, select QA-RACE-DUPLICATE in both, submit Preview simultaneously, then commit both. One job imports; the second fails with FileNotFoundError renaming .staging-31e81a87b8d0b773.
Impact: Operators can create a failed job from a normal double-submit/two-tab action; staging integrity and restart recovery become ambiguous.
Required Fix: Add a database-backed active-job uniqueness guard per canonical folder identity; make Preview and Commit idempotent; return the existing job instead of creating a duplicate.

Finding: snapims up can continue launching an older project/service after v0.13.0 installation.
Reproduction: Owner machine: snapims version returned 0.13.0, but snapims up launched /home/isaiah/Projects/SnapIMS and logged SnapIMS 0.12.3 starting. The old code then refused schema 14 and Home returned HTTP 500.
Impact: Upgrade can render the application unavailable immediately after a successful database migration.
Required Fix: Installer must detect and replace/rewrite existing service and launcher paths, show the resolved executable/project path, refuse mixed code/schema startup, and verify Home after installation.

Finding: Batch Editor performs full-table server rendering and sends every item plus JSON to the browser.
Reproduction: Load synthetic batches: 1,000 rows took 3.020 s DOMContentLoaded and 4,527,628 bytes; 5,000 rows took 11.593 s and 22,664,709 bytes. Route calls list_editor_items without paging.
Impact: Large batches freeze or heavily delay an older 8 GB workstation and violate the release requirement against full-table rendering.
Required Fix: Implement server-side pagination or bounded lazy loading, preserve selection semantics across pages, and keep normal navigation under one second.

Reproduction: Focus a Tags cell, select destination rows, press Fill Down. Toast: Fill Down is not supported for tag_ids.
Impact: A common batch operation requires repetitive per-row entry or a separate bulk-action workflow.
Required Fix: Map tag_ids to a validated atomic set/copy-tags action using immutable approved Tag IDs and add browser coverage.

Finding: Fill Down for Location is broken by a stale field identifier.
Reproduction: Focus Location and press Fill Down. Toast: Fill Down is not supported for location. The JavaScript map contains shelf: set_location while the UI field is location.
Impact: The primary batch-location workflow cannot use the advertised spreadsheet-style command.
Required Fix: Replace the stale shelf key with location, normalize blank/None to unassigned, preserve location history, and add tests.

Finding: Fill Down rejects Review and Rare checkbox columns.
Reproduction: Focus Review or Rare and press Fill Down. Toast reports unsupported field.
Impact: Operators cannot propagate common review flags through the same workflow used by other columns.
Required Fix: Add safe boolean fill-down actions with clear source-state copying, atomic updates, audit entries, and tests.

Finding: Horizontal arrow navigation stops at the Tags column.
Reproduction: Place the caret at the end of Price and press ArrowRight; focus remains price_cents. Press ArrowLeft from Discount; focus remains discount_percent.
Impact: Keyboard operators cannot traverse the complete row and may believe a command was ignored.
Required Fix: In moveHorizontal, route tag-picker targets through focusTagInput like focusSameField already does; add left/right browser tests.

Finding: Selected rows remain armed after filtering hides them.
Reproduction: Search to show one row, select it, then change the filter/search so zero rows are visible. Counter remains 1 selected and bulk actions still target the invisible row.
Impact: An operator can change hidden inventory without seeing the destination rows.
Required Fix: Clear hidden selections on filter changes or explicitly show hidden-selected count and require confirmation before applying a bulk action.

Finding: Bulk Location help text still says it moves tapes to a shelf.
Reproduction: Open the Bulk Location action. Description: Moves selected tapes to this shelf, while v0.13.0 accepts arbitrary free-text locations and unassigned.
Impact: Stale wording contradicts the new folder/location model and can mislead first-time operators.
Required Fix: Replace shelf-specific wording throughout current UI and documentation with location/unassigned terminology.
